
---

### Install (Windows)

Download **`Wireloom-Setup-<version>.exe`** below and run it. It installs for your user only (no admin
rights) and opens `.wireloom` files on double-click. Installed copies update themselves from this page.

> **"Windows protected your PC"** — the installer isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about an
> unknown publisher. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

> **Early version.** Module pinouts marked *unverified* are modelled from common boards, not measured from
> yours — hover each pin and compare it with your module's silkscreen before soldering.

`latest.yml` and the `.blockmap` are for the built-in updater; you don't need to download them.
